takeaway: The forecast picks better leaders than raw momentum but orders them worse: the apps only it put in its top 100 outgrew the momentum-only picks on every day checked. Tencent confirmed WorkBuddy's $500M annualized gross revenue (a seven-day run rate) as China's office agents traded numbers.

findings.heading: The forecast chooses leaders better than momentum alone
findings.text: The forecast's and a relative-gain baseline's top 100s share about half their apps. On Nov 6-13 the apps only the forecast picked grew more (mean realised percentile 0.86-0.90) than those only the baseline picked (0.84-0.88); the weak top-100 score comes from ordering.

findings.heading: Tencent WorkBuddy: $500M annualized gross revenue
findings.text: Martin Lau said WorkBuddy's annualized gross revenue over the past seven days exceeded $500 million; it is a seven-day run rate and includes payments to model vendors.

findings.heading: Baidu KOOKO: 50 million monthly users
findings.text: Baidu's AI office assistant KOOKO (Kuku AI) reached 50 million monthly active users worldwide.

findings.heading: GC AI: $40M ARR, up 4x in a year
findings.text: The legal AI company passed $40 million in annual recurring revenue, growing 4x year over year.

findings.heading: A local personal agent quadruples its pace
findings.text: simplexai-labs/linger, an agent that runs fully on a PC, gained 1,359 stars in a day to 2,107, up from 314 a day.

caveats: No GitHub trending data today: the pages read were stale (every repo below its API star count) and were not ingested.
WorkBuddy's $500M is a seven-day annualized gross figure, not recurring revenue.
Hacker News and npm remain unreachable from the cloud environment.
